# Cureton–Thorner Dedekind zeta library

The Lean library and `LICENSE` are copied byte for byte from the Axiom Math repository at commit `09afbb4ce6570c1615d58509dc197fc9f0956b7d`. The upstream development credits Dean Cureton, Jesse Thorner, and AxiomProver. [Upstream source](https://github.com/AxiomMath/DedekindZetaZeroFree/tree/09afbb4ce6570c1615d58509dc197fc9f0956b7d)

The package configuration uses the sibling class field theory package from the same commit and the original Mathlib revision. It omits the unused Tau Ceti dependency and the upstream submission targets. All Lean declarations and proof sources are preserved.
